name: RedisInsight
description: RedisInsight - The GUI for Redis. Take your productivity to the next level when developing with Redis or Redis Stack! Use RedisInsight to visualize and optimize Redis data. A powerful desktop manager, RedisInsight provides an intuitive and efficient UI for Redis and Redis Stack and supports CLI interaction in a fully-featured desktop UI client. In case of permission error, open terminal and run : "chmod 777 /mnt/user/appdata/redisinsight/"
